description: This source file implements the AdbIOCompletion class, which provides a wrapper around the Windows OVERLAPPED structure for asynchronous I/O operations in the context of ADB (Android Debug Bridge). The class manages overlapped I/O completion checks and resource management related to asynchronous I/O tasks.

classes.name: AdbIOCompletion
classes.description: A wrapper class around Windows OVERLAPPED structure for managing asynchronous I/O operations related to ADB.
